SOCIAL NAVIGATION

Social now appears as a standard left-menu destination directly beneath Friends on every main-menu page. The separate upper-right main-menu launcher has been removed.

The Social row uses the same active treatment as other destinations and shows pending lobby invitations, friend requests, or unread-message counts while collapsed. Selecting another page closes the drawer and highlights the chosen destination normally.

The fixed CHAT & SOCIAL control used during matches is unchanged.
